source.title: Use the real Ptyxis tab tree to verify C2 terminal workspace
source.objective: C2 terminal workspace cleanup counted active ptyxis-spawn scopes as open tabs, reporting 3 while 13 tabs remained visible. Require a GUI tab census before and after any terminal intervention and reconcile to one window with Dashboard, Codex Executor, and Watchdog.
